name: penny-platform
description: Penny.rent — in-house free-floating e-scooter sharing platform (Greece). Rider + Ops + Admin + Gateway.

pnpm.//: esbuild's postinstall places its platform binary. pnpm blocks install scripts by default, so without this every `pnpm install` leaves Vite (the admin panel) without a working esbuild until someone runs `pnpm rebuild esbuild` by hand.
pnpm.//overrides: Two copies of @types/react (18.3.31 via react-native-svg and react-dom's typings, 19.1.17 via the apps) gave every app two structurally identical but nominally different ReactNode types, so passing a node from one into a component typed against the other failed. It surfaced as apps/rider Icon.tsx:443 and had CI red on every branch since 2026-08-10. React itself is 19 everywhere; only the typings disagreed.
